text:
Leah J.: quick q — we had a team bridge day on 2026-05-03 and a couple of engineers reported that sick bank hours were used instead of the paid bridge-day policy. Not sure if it's a policy config or manager selection issue. @people-ops? :thinking:
Jordan (People Ops): Oof — thanks for flagging. Can you paste the employee IDs and the dates they booked so payroll can check? We need manager approval if we adjust balances.
Leah J.: Sure — small team of 3. They were told to use "bridge day (paid)" in manager note but HRIS shows deduction from sick bank.
Ellen (Manager): Confirm I told them bridge day was paid. Sorry for the mix-up — approve any corrections.
Leah J.: sanitized list from HRIS export:
- eid:42001 K. Nguyen — booked 2026-05-03 as bridge day, deducted sick 8h
- eid:42002 R. Patel — booked 2026-05-03 as bridge day, deducted sick 8h
- eid:42003 S. Ortiz — booked 2026-05-03 as bridge day, deducted sick 8h
Marcus (Payroll): looping in payroll ops. Likely mapping bug between manager note and time-off code. We can reverse sick usage and credit bridge-day paid hours if manager attests. I'll run the adjustment once Jordan confirms audit notes attached. Command to run:
```bash
payroll_tools/transfer_timeoff --from sick --to bridge_paid --ids 42001,42002,42003 --note "bridge-day-mapping-fix" --audit "Ellen approval"
```
HRIS Bot: detected time-off code mismatch during normalization for region US-MT; created ticket HRIS-2026-882
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks Marcus. Ellen's approval is in thread. Marcus — please proceed and attach the manager note to the audit record. Also add a detection rule to catch when booking text contains "bridge" but code != bridge_paid.
Marcus (Payroll): Will do. Adjustment queued, will reflect on next payroll sync. Also adding detection PAY_RULE_055 to flag free-text vs code mismatches.
Leah J.: Confirmed employees report corrected balances in portal after sync. Thanks! :raised_hands:
Ellen (Manager): Appreciate the quick help. I'll remind managers to select the explicit "bridge day" option in the booking flow so this doesn't repeat.
Jordan (People Ops): Adding a short FAQ for managers: "If you approve a paid bridge day, select code `bridge_paid` in HRIS booking or include `#bridge_paid` tag in notes. People Ops will not auto-convert free-text without manager attestation." Filing incident HR-2026-883 for audit.
Leah J.: All good from my side. Closing thread. If anyone else sees bridge-day deductions hitting sick, ping me or Jordan directly. :slightly_smiling_face:
